entries.018960ff2f0b35cf: Revenue for the fiscal year ended June 2026 was ¥7,035 million, with Construction Business ¥3,282 million, Building Materials Business ¥3,086 million, Alcoholic Beverage Business ¥294 million and Other Business ¥372 million. This was a decrease of 10.3% from the previous consolidated fiscal year.
entries.0a82ea557fc26ef5: In the Construction Business it takes orders for and executes civil engineering and building construction work, and in the Building Materials Business it manufactures and sells crushed stone, crushed sand and ready-mixed concrete; it also handles alcoholic beverage manufacturing and sales in Vietnam.
entries.13912c209d4bee61: The group owns crushed stone quarries and ready-mixed concrete plants, and has a structure that allows it to supply the materials needed for construction work within the group.
entries.19f9e818b1fcb9ed: The Construction Business and the Building Materials Business account for about 9 tenths of net sales. In the fiscal year ended June 2026, the 21.5% decrease in net sales of the Building Materials Business from the previous consolidated fiscal year was the main factor in the overall decline in revenue.

entries.309d3914c0e1a82d: HUE FOODS COMPANY LIMITED manufactures and sells alcoholic beverages and other products in the Socialist Republic of Vietnam, and Hue Foods Japan imports, wholesales and sells at retail shochu and other products produced in that country. entries.51f125222e9d838d: It has set out “stability and growth of the company,” “happiness of employees” and “contribution to the local community” as its management philosophy, and makes realizing these a major theme. As priority issues to address, it cites, for the Construction Business, improving construction management capability and technical proposal capability, securing stable orders with an emphasis on profitability, and promoting the securing and development of personnel; and, for the Building Materials Business, improving production efficiency, reducing manufacturing costs, and promoting appropriate negotiation of sales unit prices.
entries.5a0d733f49312f81: It is a business model that, through consolidated subsidiaries, takes orders for and executes civil engineering and building construction work and manufactures and sells crushed stone and ready-mixed concrete, and also handles alcoholic beverage manufacturing and sales in Vietnam.
